cohort: 129 newborn neonates classified into three groups based on the severity of respiratory disorder (severe, mild-to-moderate, or no disorder).
finding: a-vCOHb values were significantly higher in control and mild-to-moderate respiratory disorder groups compared to the severe disorder group, and an a-vCOHb cut-off value of 0.3% showed good predictive utility for the need for respiratory support.
cross-section timing: at the time of admission in the early neonatal period, soon after birth
